scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @wasli/shared && npm run build -w @wasli/validation && npm run build -w @wasli/config
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @wasli/api && npm run build -w @wasli/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck -w @wasli/shared && npm run typecheck -w @wasli/validation && npm run typecheck -w @wasli/config && npm run typecheck -w @wasli/api && npm run typecheck -w @wasli/web && npm run typecheck -w @wasli/mobile
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run db:generate && npm run test -w @wasli/shared && npm run test -w @wasli/validation && npm run test -w @wasli/config && npm run test -w @wasli/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && npm run db:generate && npm run test:integration -w @wasli/api
